title: The Forbidden Experiment
summary: Deep beneath Incheon Subsea Tunnel Shaft 4, Ha-Jun discovers Dr. Vance attempting to open the Grand Void Gate using a synthetic replica of Tae-Jun's heart core.

panels.shot: abandoned incheon subsea rail tunnel in pitch blackness
panels.action: A massive circular concrete railway tunnel stretches into endless darkness under the Yellow Sea, sea water leaking from overhead seams.

panels.shot: distant hum of void energy vibrating through railroad tracks
panels.action: The steel train tracks hum and vibrate with electric purple resonance; miniature violet sparks dance across the rails.

panels.shot: ha-jun, baek, and min-jae jogging down the tunnel with flashlights
panels.action: The trio sprints along the maintenance catwalk; Ha-Jun's eyes illuminate the path ahead in soft violet light.

panels.shot: kuro flapping ahead sensing dimensional distortion
panels.action: Kuro glides ahead: 'The spatial fabric is paper-thin here. A massive dimensional gate is actively drawing power.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Spatial distortion critical hai. Wo log portal ko forcefully tear kar rahe hain.

panels.shot: opening into colossal underground subterranean cavern under the seabed
panels.action: The rail tunnel opens into a gargantuan subterranean chamber carved directly into sea bedrock, 200 feet high.

panels.shot: in center: titanic 80-foot void gate framed by obsidian pillars
panels.action: In the cavern center stands an eighty-foot archway of black volcanic stone, covered in writhing tentacles and glowing magenta runes.

panels.shot: vance standing on elevated control platform in exosuit
panels.action: On a suspended steel platform stands Dr. Victor Vance—now encased in an eight-foot heavy titanium combat exosuit.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: You are too late, boy! The catalyst is already synchronizing!

panels.shot: floating in the center of the gate: glowing synthetic heart core
panels.action: Suspended in magnetic confinement rings at the gate's center: an artificial beating heart glowing with pulsating cyan and crimson blood.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: A cloned organ cultured from your brother's marrow! The perfect key!

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes widening in horror seeing his brother's blood desecrated
panels.action: Ha-Jun stares at the suspended heart; its rhythmic beat resonates painfully in his own chest.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun hyung ke DNA se banaya gaya nakli heart... How dare they?!

panels.shot: fifty void cultists and cyber-hunters aiming rifles down from gantries
panels.action: Across the metal catwalks above, fifty heavily armed cultists and cybernetic mercenaries cock weapons simultaneously.

panels.shot: baek and min-jae taking cover behind concrete rail bumpers
panels.action: Baek and Min-Jae dive behind heavy concrete rail stops: 'Ha-Jun! We will suppress the catwalks! You take Vance!'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Min-Jae, left flank! Ha-Jun, don't let that gate fully open!

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping into the open ignoring the storm of bullets
panels.action: Ha-Jun walks into the hail of machine-gun fire; a three-inch violet mana barrier deflects every single bullet effortlessly.

panels.shot: ha-jun summoning bone of the forgotten into left hand
panels.action: The ancient Bone of the Forgotten relic materializes in Ha-Jun's left hand, transforming into a 10-foot skeletal scythe.

panels.shot: ha-jun swinging bone scythe in a 360-degree horizontal wave
panels.action: Ha-Jun sweeps the scythe horizontally; a 100-foot crescent shockwave of spectral white bone blades sweeps through the gantries.

panels.shot: all gantry supports sheared cleanly collapsing into the chasm
panels.action: The steel support pillars are severed like toothpicks; gantries, cultists, and catwalks collapse in an avalanche of twisted metal.

panels.shot: vance launching from platform with rocket thrusters
panels.action: Vance ignites plasma thrusters on his exosuit's back, rocketing straight down toward Ha-Jun with a heavy hydraulic pile-bunker.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: DIE LIKE YOUR PARENTS, KANG HA-JUN!!

panels.shot: vance pile-bunker slamming down into ha-jun raised palm
panels.action: Vance's five-ton hydraulic fist smashes down—and is caught cold in the palm of Ha-Jun's bare right hand.

panels.shot: vance exosuit alarms screaming: 'MAXIMUM TORQUE INSUFFICIENT'
panels.action: Inside Vance's cockpit, red emergency warnings flash: 'Hydraulic arm integrity 12%... Target's grip exceeding 800 metric tons!'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: Impossible! My suit has the strength of a hydraulic press!

panels.shot: ha-jun crushing the titanium pile-bunker into twisted scrap
panels.action: Ha-Jun's fingers squeeze; the reinforced tungsten-titanium fist folds, groans, and implodes like an empty soda can.

panels.shot: ha-jun driving a knee strike into vance chest armor
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives a mana-charged knee strike into the exosuit's chestplate, blowing the heavy armor plating out its back.

panels.shot: vance flying backward 100 feet crashing into gate pedestal
panels.action: The shattered exosuit skids across the stone floor, slamming violently into the obsidian base of the Void Gate.

panels.shot: vance cockpit ejecting revealing bloody, broken old man
panels.action: The damaged cockpit pops open; Dr. Vance crawls out onto his knees, bleeding profusely from his nose and mouth.

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: You... You are not human... You are a monster...

panels.shot: ha-jun standing over vance looking down with cold eyes
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands over the broken scientist, his silhouette framed by the swirling purple vortex of the gate behind him.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Maine kabhi nahi kaha main insaan hoon. I am the Demon Sovereign.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking up at the floating synthetic heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks up at the artificial heart; its erratic pulse is destabilizing the gate, causing sea water to flood through the ceiling.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaping up and gently cupping the synthetic heart
panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps forty feet into the air, cradling the synthetic heart in both hands with brotherly tenderness.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Rest now. You don't have to suffer anymore.

panels.shot: ha-jun channeling his pure sovereign mana into the heart
panels.action: Golden and violet sovereign mana washes over the synthetic heart, soothing its torment and turning its black miasma into clean starlight.

panels.shot: the synthetic heart dissolving into peaceful golden embers
panels.action: The artificial heart peacefully dissolves into thousands of golden light particles, sinking into Ha-Jun's chest.

panels.shot: the void gate roaring as its catalyst is removed
panels.action: Without the catalyst, the Void Gate begins to violently convulse, sucking surrounding rubble into its dimensional core.

panels.shot: vance screaming as the vortex pulls him toward the abyss
panels.action: Vance screams as the gravitational pull drags him into the event horizon: 'No! The void will devour me!'

dialogue.speaker: vance
dialogue.text: SAVE ME, SOVEREIGN! DON'T LET THEM CONSUME ME!!

panels.shot: vance vanishing into the void as ha-jun turns away cliffhanger
panels.action: Vance vanishes into the pitch-black abyss; Ha-Jun turns his back calmly as the vortex opens a stable dimensional wormhole to Tartarus.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Portal stable ho chuka hai. The path to Tartarus is open.
